verdict.score_rationale: This lands at 6.5 because the board has deliberate regional styling, readable semantics, and substantial operational-map vocabulary, but the oversized empty upper-right band and several awkward routing joins keep it from feeling fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The four numbered regions occupy meaningful zones, but a very large unexplained empty band dominates the upper center and right, making the lower content feel disproportionately packed.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Teal consistently identifies AI self-service, yellow marks human support, blue marks recordings and review flow, green marks queue/resolution, and gray supports neutral process steps with good text contrast.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair waypoints are visible, but the long return paths around the AI decision, queue, and review areas create awkward near-merges and attachment points that expose routing mechanics.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: Local peers such as the intake process boxes and AI tools align reasonably well, yet region sizes, vertical placement, connector lengths, and the oversized handoff note produce uneven rhythm and a weak global register.
